Take campaign-curator-vm-v1305b (1214bw): the VM client paused at the same point (the host's skiff departure) and its level transition still expired (received 2, applied 1). Hypothesis confirmed by the code path: the pause menu stops the engine services, so 1214bw's refresh never ran while paused, and the first service after resuming saw more than 60 s. 1214bx shifts the timer by the time without a service call. The route's expect step also presses B for a world in the pause menu while waiting. Why the VM client loses focus at that moment is not known (hypothesis: a guest-side window or notification).
